Technical Product Manager

Contoso Harbor is a fictional media-data company. This role owns data quality workflows on an existing platform, not a 0-to-1 build.

Requirements:
- Product management for data remediation and source-of-truth workflows
- Partner with engineering and DBA teams on sequencing
- Translate messy operational problems into a backlog

Preferred:
- Familiarity with SQL investigation
- Experience with customer-facing reporting quality

Responsibilities:
- Prioritize data defects against customer impact
- Keep legal and CX in the loop on high-risk changes
